Name: Auto Fishing 2.0
Author: Tibsz
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5235][img]https://i.imgur.com/UpP6nGn.jpeg[/img]

ORIGINAL MOD BY SORRYLATE

[/url][b]Auto Fishing 2.0[/b] picks up where [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/62868866]SorryLate[/url] left off his original Auto Fishing mod.

It introduces features like automatic casting, hitting, and fish catching, all while considering the player's stamina levels.

With configurable options, players can set thresholds for when the auto-casting should stop based on stamina, ensuring a balanced and enjoyable gameplay experience. Perfect for those who want to maximize their fishing efficiency without the constant manual effort.
[size=4]
[b][u]Features:[/u][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Automatic Casting[/b]: Set your rod to cast automatically when conditions are ideal, making fishing more efficient.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Intelligent Hit Detection:[/b] Automatically detect when fish bite and hook them without manual input.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Stamina Threshold Management:[/b] Configure the mod to stop auto-casting when your stamina falls below a set level, preventing exhaustion.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Adjustable Casting Power[/b]: Control the casting power through in-game settings, allowing for precise control over fishing mechanics.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Fish Catching Automation:[/b] Automatically reel in and catch fish once hooked, streamlining the fishing process.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Customizable Configuration[/b]: Fine-tune the mod's behavior to fit your playstyle with various configurable settings.[/size]
[/list]

[u][b][size=4]Configuration:[/size][/b][/u]
After running the game with Auto Fishing 2.0 for the first time, a config.json file will be created in the mod's directory. You can open this file with any text editor to customize the following settings:

[list]
[*][b]AutoCast[/b]: Enable or disable automatic casting. Default is false.
[*][b]AutoHit[/b]: Enable or disable the automatic fish hooking when it nibbles your line. Default is true.
[*][b]AutoFish[/b]: Enable or disable skipping the fishing mini-game. Default is true.
[*][b]CaughtDoubleFish[/b]: Set if the player will always catch two fish at once. Default is false.
[*][b]ActiveAutoCastButton[/b]: Keybind to activate AutoCast. Default is V.
[*][b]ActiveAutoFishButton[/b]: Keybind to activate AutoFish. Default is X.
[*][b]IncreasePowerButton[/b]: Keybind to increase casting power. Default is + on the numpad.
[*][b]DecreasePowerButton[/b]: Keybind to decrease casting power. Default is - on the numpad.
[*][b]CastingPower[/b]: Sets the casting power value, with a maximum of 1.0f and a minimum of 0.0. Default is 1.0.
[*][b]StaminaThreshold[/b]: Sets the stamina level at which auto-casting will stop. Default is 25.0, 0.0 disables this option.
[/list][b][u]
[/u][/b]
[b][u][size=4]Important:[/size][/u][/b]
This mod may have several bugs, please report any that you encounter while keeping duplicate bug reports to a minimum.
